entries.title: Fictional City University
bullets: Studied asset pricing, statistical modeling, and computational finance; used Python, SQL, and Excel in research assignments and case analyses.

entries.title: Northstar Data Lab
bullets: Built monthly operating-analysis datasets for consumer and industrial clients, standardizing sales, channel, and inventory definitions into traceable SQL detail tables.
Cleaned multi-source transaction records with Python, identified unusual movements, and drafted weekly insights that focused project reviews on the highest-priority questions.

entries.title: Harborline Systems
bullets: Contributed to subscription-retention analysis by organizing customer lifecycle, feature-usage, and support-tag data into practical segmentation views for quarterly reviews.
Maintained Excel models and presentation templates, replacing manual consolidation steps with parameterized refresh workflows for more consistent cross-team reporting.

entries.title: Starlane Research Advisory
bullets: Organized company disclosures, capacity plans, and public-market data across a fictional clean-energy supply chain into a searchable research workpaper.
Updated weekly industry charts from interview notes and public sources, checking citations and calculation definitions for analyst discussion materials.

entries.title: Retail Demand Signal Platform
bullets: Designed data models and REST APIs with FastAPI and PostgreSQL for orders, products, and demand signals, supporting queries by category, time window, and store.
Implemented asynchronous ingestion and aggregation jobs with batch-level status, error, and version tracking; added Redis caching for frequently requested queries.
Containerized the API, database, and worker services with Docker Compose, then added pytest coverage and GitHub Actions checks for core import and query paths.

entries.title: Industry Research Knowledge Base
bullets: Built a Next.js and TypeScript search interface for research materials, with composable filters for keywords, industry, publication date, and tags plus source links and pagination.
Designed a PostgreSQL schema and Python ingestion scripts for document metadata, summaries, tags, and source URLs, including deduplication and full-text search indexing.
Implemented server-side validation and audit logging for material uploads, edits, and deletions, with component and API tests for search, pagination, and authorization boundaries.

entries.title: City Budget Scenario Simulator
bullets: Developed an interactive budget-simulation web app with Python, Streamlit, and Plotly, exposing population, tax, and public-service assumptions as real-time controls.
Implemented the budget-calculation module and input-validation rules, clearly separating historical data, user assumptions, and model outputs with readable error handling.
Built scenario-comparison charts and CSV export, documented local deployment, and managed versions with Git so others could reproduce and extend the simulation logic.
Data and programming: Python (pandas, NumPy, matplotlib), SQL, and Git; comfortable building clear data-cleaning, validation, and reproducible-analysis scripts.
Languages: Mandarin Chinese (native) and English (professional reading and written communication).
